Papyra.//DataDir: Local dev runtime data lives in a gitignored .localdata folder beside the API, kept separate from the Data/ source namespace so it can never collide with it.

Collab.//: Dev only: `pnpm dev` runs the collab engine itself (tsx watch, papyra.collab/.env.development) on this port with this secret, so the API connects instead of spawning it. Production generates a fresh secret each boot and spawns the bundled engine.
